steps.speaker: Defeated Draco
steps.content: O Hero... So what you are holding is... the Sacred Sword?!

steps.speaker: Defeated Draco
steps.content: Nooo!!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No need to repeat your deathbed lines. I don't want to kill you.

steps.content: You stick the Sacred Sword into the ground in front of him, then sit down before the huddled dragon.

This dream is far too hollow. The enclosed time and space, the flimsy little village, the ice-cold blacksmith forge, the preprogrammed Hero NPC, and the lonely spirit-forger who makes swords day in and day out.
There's no enchanting scenery, no heart-wrenching sentiment. Even the Blacksmith in the dream is different from the havoc-seeking Sinner Mess in real life.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I am the spirit-forger Mess. I extract malice from people's hearts to forge weapons. The evil thoughts of hurting others will become the power of this sword.
The key to understanding this world already lies in everything before you. The core of this dream is the endlessly repeating storyline, and the eternal slaying of Draco by the Sacred Sword.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: You're not the Hero... What do you want?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I want to understand this world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To Mess... To the Blacksmith, what are you? What is the Sacred Sword? Why does her dream look like this?

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: Who is Mess... Who is the Blacksmith... Grrr... I don't care about them...

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: I am Draco, the ruler of darkness, the source of all evil. Everyone in this world fears me because I am the most powerful. I am unbeatable... I shall destroy everything...!
Mess is the only real "person" in this world. Does Mess think of him as the most powerful and unbeatable in her heart?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even without the Sacred Sword, I can tip you over with one finger.
Draco roars.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: That's because my true power has been stolen! My ☐☐!

He roars, and some of his words turn into gibberish that you're not able to understand. Before you get the chance to ask what ☐☐ is, Draco is already bellowing as if his mouth is full of firecrackers.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: I was originally the source of all ☐☐! I planted ☐☐ in people's hearts, and the ☐☐ became my strength! That's the way it should be!

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: But someone simply feared me for being powerful. She feared ☐☐, so this world stole my power! I don't have any ☐☐ anymore! All the ☐☐ in this world has been taken away!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: He is the source of all malice, the culprit who defiles people's hearts, and the most terrifying monster in the world...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Does ☐☐ mean the malice in people's hearts?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When you say ☐☐, do you mean the ☐☐ in people's hearts?
You realize your words have been censored when they leave your mouth. This world expels all "malice," or rather, Ambrosia expels all "malice."
To create the perfect dream for Mess, it must expel everything that might upset her, which includes the concept of "malice." That's why Draco has lost his power, just like the Sacred Sword.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. Only sorcery can defeat sorcery.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Only with a sacred sword forged from malice can we defeat the source of all evil—the Great Dreadlord!
You stand up, pull out the shining golden Sacred Sword that's supposed to be invincible and save the world, and smash it hard onto the ground...
Snap!
The sword breaks and emits dazzling light, just like what happened to Draco the first time. It's not some great power, but just a super big lightbulb that the Ambrosia conjured up to please Mess.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: Ahhh... You... Why?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm here to seek the truth, to find out how to advance the storyline.

steps.content: Forging the Sacred Sword consumes Ambrosia, while the Sacred Sword itself can be destroyed. If the Blacksmith becomes unable to forge the Sacred Sword anymore...
Maybe the hidden mission will be activated, and the storyline will progress without clearing the level.
You return to Mess's blacksmith forge. Most everything is the same as before. The deserted shop, the ugly clay dolls... but the Ambrosia in the bottle looks a bit less than before.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
She doesn't recite her set lines from the first encounter. In her eyes, the Hero is in possession of the Sacred Sword... but you plan to change all that.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: O Blacksmith, the Sacred Sword is broken...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the... What did you say?!
As if suddenly electrocuted, she jumps up and shakes you by the collar.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That Sacred Sword was my flesh and blood! It was the key to defeating the Dreadlord! The Sacred Sword is invincible. How can it be broken?!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What kind of useless Hero are you?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Maybe it was a glitch in the program.
Draco's too strong. He broke the Sacred Sword.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Without the Sacred Sword, I have no way to defeat Draco.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ... My poor Sacred Sword... Sob... You have to have the key item. I must forge another one for you. Wait here... Sob...
She fetches the bottle of Ambrosia from the top shelf again, and repeats all the steps. After some more toil, she comes to you with a second Sacred Sword.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
You smile and accept the Sacred Sword. After making sure the amount of Ambrosia in the glass bottle has lessened, you leave the forge and venture out of Mess's sight.
Snap!
When you came back this time, she didn't even have time to put away the Ambrosia. All she can do is stare blankly at you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: O Blacksmith, the Sacred Sword is broken...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...My poor Sacred Sword!!!
